items.title: Moonshot released Kimi K3 weights
items.oneliner: Moonshot open-sourced a 2.8T MoE with 104B active parameters. Open models are now competing on frontier turf.

items.title: Kimi Linear cuts attention costs
items.oneliner: Kimi Linear claims 75% less KV cache and 6x faster decoding. Long-context serving just got cheaper.

items.title: Microsoft shipped a cheaper cyber model
items.oneliner: Microsoft says MAI-Cyber-1-Flash hits 96% on CyberGym at half the cost. Security copilots are getting specialized.

items.title: AMD released its first open MoE
items.oneliner: AMD's 16B Instella-MoE ships fully open with training details. Open model credibility now includes reproducibility.

items.title: OpenAI and JFrog disclosed zero-days
items.oneliner: OpenAI models found exploitable zero-days with JFrog. Fast remediation is becoming the only security story that matters.

items.title: Apple patched macOS Tahoe vulnerabilities
items.oneliner: Apple's macOS Tahoe 26.6 fixes privilege, sandbox, and data exposure bugs. Update lag is now a real enterprise risk.

items.title: Most domains still skip DMARC enforcement
items.oneliner: 68.4% of domains still do not enforce DMARC. Phishing remains easier than most security teams admit.

items.title: Nvidia launched an AI security alliance
items.oneliner: Nvidia and 36 partners formed an open AI security alliance. Defenders are finally coordinating like attackers already do.

items.title: OpenAI mapped work across job boundaries
items.oneliner: OpenAI says 43.5% of work-related ChatGPT use crosses job roles. Product design should target skills, not titles.

items.title: Yap brought local dictation to macOS
items.oneliner: Yap delivers open-source on-device dictation for macOS with no accounts or model downloads. Privacy-first UX is shipping.
